newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE SET TO MISS OUT AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE SET TO MISS OUT AGAIN.

text.p: World record try scorer David Campese again looks like being relegated to Australia's replacements' bench for Sunday's rugby union test against Wales at Cardiff Arms Park.

Campese, who won his 100th cap in Italy last month, has been named in a 21-man squad for the game, but the Wallabies will probably stick with the backs who were on duty for last Saturday's 22-12 win over Ireland in Dublin.
Lock David Giffin is likely to take over in the second row from skipper John Eales, who suffered a nasty eye injury during the Ireland game and will take no further part in the tour.
Owen Finegan is set to replace Daniel Manu in the back row.
